title: U.S. forces withdraw from Iraq after Operation Inherent Resolve began in 2014
description: The U.S. military finished withdrawing from Iraq, 23 years after its 2003 invasion and 12 years after ramping up efforts against ISIS with Operation Inherent Resolve. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio reports.

title: Trump says vague AI agreement is "almost like a constitution," tells tech giants self-regulate
description: President Trump and major artificial intelligence executives signed a "morally binding" safety agreement. CBS News' Aaron Navarro explains the contents of the agreement.

title: What to know as Tennessee plans to execute first woman in 200 years
description: Christa Pike is scheduled to die by lethal injection Wednesday in Tennessee. If it proceeds as planned, she would be the first woman executed in Tennessee since at least 1820.

title: Pilot reportedly stabs another on Israel-bound plane, concerns of possible hijacking
description: A commercial flight from Dubai to Israel made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after a reported fight between the plane's two pilots. CBS News senior reporter Dov Lieber has more details.

title: Eye Opener: Storms sweep across Southwest
description: Storms sweeping through the Southwest are causing major flooding. Meanwhile, public outrage continues to grow as new details emerge on the Cornell rape case. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

title: Fed’s Preferred Inflation Gauge Points to Continued Price Pressures
